# Can’t Explain

> A receipt-first hall of ridiculous claims. Low-evidence, high-emotion accusations, pinned to original sources and Git-timestamped evidence.

- Canonical: https://cantexplain.au
- Repository: https://github.com/coldix/cantexplain
- Author: Colin Dixon
- Publisher: Oze

## What this site is

A collection of political accusations that arrived at high volume with thin evidence. Each entry has:

1. The claim (quote or marked paraphrase)
2. Original source URL + date
3. A file in git under /evidence (the timestamp)
4. A short observational caption

It is not a news site, not a how-to-vote, and not a comments section.

## Family

- https://ministryofdoubt.com — suspicion is not proof; authority is not proof either
- https://electiontracker.au — sourced Australian election ledger
- https://ozeunleashed.substack.com — longer essays
